register.claim: the graft's ordering cost (12-20 kcal/mol) is a property of the construct that no redesign can reduce
register.actual: WP45 built the linker from GGGGG. Glycine has no Cbeta and therefore the largest backbone state space of any residue, so WP45 chose the most expensive possible 5-mer and then reported its cost as unpayable. AAPAP-type linkers are 2.84 kcal/mol cheaper on the same state model, and the ranking is stable under an alternative model
register.predicate: a linker not dominated by glycine costs less to order than GGGGG on the same accounting
register.replaced_by: the PAPAP-linked construct DXEEKEFPAPAPFSXLPTE (WP48); the conclusion that the construct still cannot pay IN FULL stands - 6.36 kcal/mol remains unpaid
